system.description:
You turn a victim's own mind against his body: he is torn apart by the force of his own will, erupting in violent stigmata — bruises, lacerations and punctures — as he sprays blood and howls in agony.

Touch him or make eye contact, spend two Willpower Traits, and defeat him in a Social Challenge. For each of the next three turns, he makes a number of Simple Tests equal to his permanent Willpower Traits, taking one level of lethal damage for each test he loses. Throughout those three turns he can take no action but thrashing, gibbering and howling — he cannot even spend blood to heal himself.
